## ⚠️ Concentration-risk caveat (the real issue isn't affordability)

**Bottom line:** You can absolutely afford it — the constraint is risk, not cash. A disciplined answer is "yes on affordability, no on doubling into a >50% single-name concentration; if you want more GME, size it to a target allocation, not to 'double.'"
